outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B consists of phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
The bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM, n=3) displays individual data points as overlaid markers (circles, squares, triangles) for each replicate on top of the bars.
The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual data points overlaid as dots on the bars for each condition.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized expression (Z-scores); heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
The RT-qPCR bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) show individual data points as overlaid markers (dots, squares, triangles) for each biological replicate.
Panel H consists of immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
